simple.meaning: רִשְׁיוֹן (rishyôwn) is a Hebrew object word meaning “a permit.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Ezra 3:7. The surrounding context includes family line, kingship.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to רִשְׁיוֹן (H7558) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
